name: "Flavor Party" Roasted Potato Wedges (Cooking with Kids)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe contains steps that can be done by smaller hands! You know your child (and their cooking abilities) best, so get them involved where you feel comfortable. Have fun!

Preheat oven to 400°F. Line two baking sheet pans with aluminum foil, then use a butter knife to mark the foil, dividing each sheet into two sections. Mark each section with the first initial of each person making their own potatoes.
Place spices each in their own small bowl or spaced apart on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp Italian seasoning
1 tsp paprika
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp onion powder

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and cut each potato lengthwise into 8 wedges. Divide potatoes between four medium bowls, drizzle each with 1 tsp oil, then season with a pinch of salt and pepper. Have each person add additional pinches of their desired spices, then use a spoon to stir and combine the potato wedges.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Transfer potatoes to each person's section of the baking sheets, spreading the wedges out in an even layer, and leaving the initials visible. Place baking sheets in the oven and roast, flipping halfway, until wedges are golden and fork-tender, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly, 5 minutes.
Divide potato wedges between plates and enjoy your creation with ketchup on the side!
